clues.title: Google car: White Dot Antenna
text: The Google Car found in Puerto Rico has an antenna at the front right.
The antenna has a small white dot on the tip.
The Google car on Guam and NMI also have an antenna at the front right.
Make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.

clues.title: 787 Phone Code
text: The entirety of Puerto Rico uses (787) as their regional phone code.
While far less common, you may also encounter the phone code 939.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Plate: No Front Plates
text: Front plates are not mandatory in Puerto Rico.
Therefore, seeing cars with front plates is rare.
This helps differentiate from Guam and Northern Mariana Islands.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Landscape: Coast
text: The North and South coasts of Puerto Rico typically feature flat coastal plains or rolling hills.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Landscape: Mountains
text: Most of the mountainous regions of Puerto Rico are located in the middle section of the country. Most of the coverage in these areas is limited to divided highways.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Southern Dryness
text: Southern Puerto Rico can often look distinctly dryer than the rest of the island.
